definition.description: One body fat percentage measurement.
One body height measurement.
One absolute body temperature measurement. Never a deviation from a baseline.
One body weight measurement.
Total energy expended over one calendar day, active and basal together.
Steps taken over one calendar day.
Time in deep sleep within one sleep period.
Energy burned through activity over one interval, excluding basal energy, in kilocalories.
Panel for the active minutes of one interval. Carries no value; the minutes per activity level are its components.
Minutes spent at activity level ACTIVITY_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED within one interval.
Minutes spent at activity level LIGHT within one interval.
Minutes spent at activity level MODERATE within one interval.
Minutes spent at an activity level the API omitted within one interval.
Minutes spent at activity level VIGOROUS within one interval.
Active Zone Minutes earned in one interval, emitted in minutes. Google counts 1 per minute in fat-burn and 2 per minute in cardio or peak, so this is not elapsed time.
Heart rate zone (FAT_BURN, CARDIO, PEAK) in which the interval earned its Active Zone Minutes.
Activity level type (SEDENTARY, LIGHTLY_ACTIVE, ...) of one interval, as a google-health coded concept.
Duration of the interval spent at the activity level, derived from its start and end.
Energy burned by basal metabolic rate over one interval, in kilocalories. Not active energy.
One glucose reading as a mass concentration, from blood or interstitial fluid; the specimen component says which.
Meal the blood glucose reading relates to (BREAKFAST, LUNCH, ...).
Timing of the blood glucose reading relative to a meal or sleep (FASTING, AFTER_MEAL, ...).
Specimen the blood glucose reading was taken from (CAPILLARY_BLOOD, INTERSTITIAL_FLUID, ...).
Body site of one core body temperature reading (ORAL, EAR, WRIST, ...).
Panel for one civil day of heart-rate-variability metrics (DailyHeartRateVariability). Carries no value; the metrics are its components.
Average heart rate variability for one civil day as RMSSD between heartbeats, in milliseconds.
RMSSD between heartbeats during deep sleep, reported for one civil day, in milliseconds.
Shannon entropy of the heartbeat-interval histogram for one civil day. Dimensionless; higher means higher HRV.
Heart rate during non-REM sleep, reported for one civil day. Not a resting heart rate.
Panel for one civil day of the user's heart rate zone thresholds (Karvonen). Carries no value; the zone limits are its components.
Configured lower heart-rate threshold of the HEART_RATE_ZONE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured minimum heart rate.
Configured upper heart-rate threshold of the HEART_RATE_ZONE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured maximum heart rate.
Configured lower heart-rate threshold of the LIGHT zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured minimum heart rate.
Configured upper heart-rate threshold of the LIGHT zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured maximum heart rate.
Configured lower heart-rate threshold of the MODERATE zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured minimum heart rate.
Configured upper heart-rate threshold of the MODERATE zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured maximum heart rate.
Configured lower heart-rate threshold of the PEAK zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured minimum heart rate.
Configured upper heart-rate threshold of the PEAK zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured maximum heart rate.
Configured lower heart-rate threshold of a zone whose type the API omitted for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured minimum heart rate.
Configured upper heart-rate threshold of a zone whose type the API omitted for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured maximum heart rate.
Configured lower heart-rate threshold of the VIGOROUS zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured minimum heart rate.
Configured upper heart-rate threshold of the VIGOROUS zone for one civil day. A zone boundary, not a measured maximum heart rate.
Average of one civil day's oxygen saturation samples, which Google takes during sleep. Not a spot reading.
Lower bound of the confidence interval of one civil day's oxygen saturation samples during sleep.
Standard deviation of the daily oxygen saturation averages over the preceding 7-30 days, reported on one civil day.
Upper bound of the confidence interval of one civil day's oxygen saturation samples during sleep.
Average respiratory rate for one civil day, which Google computes over that day's main sleep. Not a mean over the whole day.
Panel for one civil day of skin-temperature values derived during sleep. Carries no value; the derivations are its components.
Baseline skin temperature reported on one civil day: the median nightly skin temperature over the preceding 30 days.
Mean of the skin temperature samples taken during one civil day's sleep. A skin temperature, not a body temperature.
Standard deviation of the nightly skin temperature relative to baseline over the preceding 30 days, as a temperature difference in kelvin.
One civil day's VO2 max (cardio fitness score) as Google summarises it, in mL/kg/min. A daily rollup, not a single reading.
Google's cardio fitness level category for one civil day, derived from VO2 max (POOR ... EXCELLENT).
Covariance of one civil day's VO2 max value, as the mapper emits it with the UCUM unity.
Distance covered over one interval, converted from the API millimetres to metres.
Panel for one ECG recording session. Carries no value and no waveform; the session metrics are its components.
Average heart rate over one ECG recording.
Number of leads used for one ECG recording.
The device's rhythm classification of one ECG recording (NORMAL_SINUS_RHYTHM, ATRIAL_FIBRILLATION, ...). Research use only; not a diagnosis.
Sampling frequency of the waveform of one ECG recording.
Elevation gained over one interval, converted from the API millimetres to metres.
Panel for one exercise session. Carries no value; the session summary metrics are its components.
Active Zone Minutes earned during one exercise session, emitted in minutes. Google counts 2 per minute in cardio or peak, so this is not elapsed time.
Average heart rate over one exercise session.
Distance covered during one exercise session, converted from the API millimetres to metres.
Elevation gained during one exercise session, converted from the API millimetres to metres.
Exercise type of one session (RUNNING, SWIMMING, ...).
Floors climbed over one interval.
One heart rate variability reading as RMSSD between normal heartbeats, in milliseconds.

Standard deviation reported with one heart rate variability reading, in milliseconds. Google documents it only as "the standard deviation of the heart rate variability measurement"; the mapper labels it SDNN.
Motion context (ACTIVE, SEDENTARY) of one heart rate reading.
Body site of the sensor for one heart rate reading (WRIST, CHEST, ...).
Volume of fluid consumed in one hydration log entry, in millilitres.
Panel for one irregular rhythm (possible AFib) notification over its analysis interval. Carries no value. Research use only; not a diagnosis.
Number of analysis windows that produced one irregular rhythm notification.
Panel for one logged food intake. Carries no value; the meal and nutrient amounts are its components.
Energy intake of one logged food, in kilocalories.
Energy from fat in one logged food, in kilocalories.
Meal one logged food intake belongs to (BREAKFAST, SNACK, ...).
Total carbohydrate in one logged food, in grams.
Total fat in one logged food, in grams.
Duration of one out-of-bed segment within a sleep session, derived from its start and end.
Duration of one sedentary period, derived from its start and end.
Panel for one sleep session (a night or a nap). Carries no value; the summary is its components and each stage segment a member Observation.
Mean respiratory rate during deep sleep within one sleep period.
Mean respiratory rate during light sleep within one sleep period.
Mean respiratory rate during REM sleep within one sleep period.
One contiguous sleep stage segment of a sleep session, its stage type as a google-health coded concept.
Duration of one sleep stage segment, derived from its start and end.
Minutes after waking at the end of one sleep period, as Google's restlessness algorithm computes them.
Minutes awake within one sleep period: the sum of its AWAKE stages.
Number of out-of-bed segments within one sleep period.
Whether one sleep session was recorded as CLASSIC or STAGES sleep.
Minutes in sleep stage ASLEEP within one sleep period, from the stage summary.
Minutes in sleep stage AWAKE within one sleep period, from the stage summary.
Minutes in sleep stage RESTLESS within one sleep period, from the stage summary.
Minutes in sleep stage SLEEP_STAGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED within one sleep period, from the stage summary.
Swim strokes over one swim-length interval.
Swim stroke type (FREESTYLE, BACKSTROKE, ...) of one swim-length interval.
Time spent in one heart rate zone over one interval, derived from its start and end.
Heart rate zone type (LIGHT, MODERATE, VIGOROUS, PEAK) the interval was spent in.
One heart rate reading at an instant or over a short sampling window.
Time in light sleep within one sleep period.
Oura Activity Score for one day: a vendor-computed 0-100 score, not a clinical measure.
Energy expended through activity over one day, excluding basal expenditure. Not the daily total energy expenditure.
Mean metabolic equivalent over one day, from Oura's average_met_minutes field.
Oura Activity Score contributor "Meet Daily Targets" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Activity Score contributor "Move Every Hour" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Activity Score contributor "Recovery Time" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Activity Score contributor "Stay Active" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Activity Score contributor "Training Frequency" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Activity Score contributor "Training Volume" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Walking distance equivalent to the activity Oura measured over one day. An estimate, not a distance travelled.
MET-minutes accumulated in high-intensity activity over one day.
Time in high-intensity activity over one day.
Number of inactivity alerts Oura raised over one day.
MET-minutes accumulated in low-intensity activity over one day.
Time in low-intensity activity over one day.
MET-minutes accumulated in medium-intensity activity over one day.
Time in medium-intensity activity over one day.
Equivalent walking distance still needed on one day to reach Oura's activity target.
Time the ring was not worn over one day.
Time resting over one day, as Oura classifies it.
MET-minutes accumulated while sedentary over one day.
Time sedentary over one day.
Oura's active-energy target for one day. A goal, not a measurement.
Oura's equivalent-walking-distance target for one day. A goal, not a measurement.
Pulse wave velocity Oura reports for one day alongside its vascular-age estimate. A daily value, not one reading.
Oura's stress summary category for one day, from a closed value set, as a CodeableConcept.
Body height as entered in the wearer's Oura profile. A profile setting with no measurement time, not a measurement.
Body weight as entered in the wearer's Oura profile. A profile setting with no measurement time, not a weighing.
Oura Readiness Score for one day: a vendor-computed 0-100 score, not a clinical measure.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "Activity Balance" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "HRV Balance" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "Previous Day Activity" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "Previous Night" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "Recovery Index" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "Resting Heart Rate" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "Sleep Balance" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Readiness Score contributor "Sleep Regularity" for one day: a vendor-computed 1-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Deviation of skin temperature from the wearer's personal baseline, as reported with one day's Readiness. A temperature difference, never an absolute body temperature.
Deviation of the wearer's skin-temperature trend from their baseline, as reported with one day's Readiness. A temperature difference, never an absolute body temperature.
Oura Resilience level for one day: a vendor category from a closed five-term value set, as a CodeableConcept.
Oura Resilience contributor "Daytime Recovery" for one day: a vendor-computed 0-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Resilience contributor "Sleep Recovery" for one day: a vendor-computed 0-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Oura Resilience contributor "Stress" for one day: a vendor-computed 0-100 contributor score, not a measurement of what it is named after.
Value-less marker of one period the wearer had Oura Rest Mode switched on. Not a measurement.
Value-less record describing one configured Oura ring; the hardware is a Device and the size is its component.
US ring size of one configured Oura ring. An ordinal label, not a length.
Value-less panel for one Oura session (meditation, breathing, nap, relaxation, rest or body status); the values are its components.
Arithmetic mean of the heart rate samples Oura recorded during one session. Not one heart rate reading.
Arithmetic mean of the heart rate variability samples Oura recorded during one session, in milliseconds.
Arithmetic mean of the motion-count samples Oura recorded during one session.
Mood the wearer reported for one session, from a closed value set, as a CodeableConcept.

Oura Sleep Score for one sleep period: a vendor-computed 0-100 score, not a clinical measure. Often absent on sleep periods, in which case the Observation carries dataAbsentReason and only groups the period components.
Mean heart rate variability over one sleep period as Oura computes it, in milliseconds. Not a contributor score.
Time awake within one sleep period, between going to bed and getting up, as Oura reports it.
Oura's 1-100 sleep efficiency rating for one sleep period, emitted as a percentage. Oura does not publish the formula.
The change one sleep period made to Oura's Readiness Score. A score difference, not a score.
Number of restless periods Oura detected within one sleep period.
The change one sleep period made to Oura's Sleep Score. A score difference, not a score.
Deviation of skin temperature during one sleep period from the wearer's personal baseline, as a temperature difference. Never an absolute body temperature.
Deviation of the wearer's skin-temperature trend from their baseline, as Oura reports it with one sleep period. A temperature difference, never an absolute body temperature.
Value-less panel grouping Oura's daily blood oxygen measurements; the values are its components.
Oura's breathing disturbance index for one day: breathing disturbances per hour, as Oura computes it. Not a clinical apnoea-hypopnoea index.
Mean peripheral oxygen saturation Oura reports for one day, averaged over the sleep it measures. A summary, not one pulse-oximetry reading.
Time Oura classified as high recovery over one day.
Time Oura classified as high stress over one day.
Oura's estimate of vascular age for one day, in years. A model output, not the wearer's chronological age.
Value-less panel for one Oura workout; the activity is its code text and the values are its components.
Distance covered during one workout.
One peripheral oxygen saturation reading by pulse oximetry, as a percentage.
Time in REM sleep within one sleep period.
Resting heart rate for one calendar day, as the source computes it. Not the minimum during sleep.
Energy expended during one exercise or activity session.
Steps taken during one exercise or activity session.
Time taken to fall asleep at the start of one sleep period.
Mean heart rate over one sleep period.
Mean respiratory rate over one sleep period.
Lowest heart rate during one sleep period. Not a resting heart rate, which is measured awake.
Steps taken over one interval that is not a calendar day, session or sleep period.
Time in bed for one sleep period, asleep or awake. Not time asleep.
Time asleep within one sleep period, excluding time awake in bed.
Peak oxygen consumption per kilogram of body weight, as one reading or estimate.
